case.summary: Case HHG-019, opened 2016-12-01, involved transaction 3503878 for $99.92 on card C07987-K2, which triggered a high risk score of 0.90. Evidence shows this was an online purchase from a new device profile never before seen on this card. The customer, C07987, denied the transaction and confirmed they still hold the card. The device profile used is linked to other cards, C06224-K2 and C11309-K1, suggesting a common actor. Based on the customer denial, new device profile, and links to other cards, the transaction is deemed fraudulent. Card C07987-K2 has been blocked, and connected cards C06224-K2 and C11309-K1 are now under monitoring. A Suspicious Activity Report is being filed.

sar.narrative: On 2016-12-01, card C07987-K2, held by customer C07987, was used for one online transaction (3503878) totaling $99.92. This transaction was flagged due to a high real-time risk score of 0.90. The purchase was made from a device profile identified as Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720, which is a new device never before seen on this card. When contacted, customer C07987 denied making the purchase and confirmed they still possess the physical card. Further investigation revealed that this same device profile was also used on two other cards, C06224-K2 and C11309-K1, indicating a potential common actor across multiple cardholders. This activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history and matches characteristics of previously confirmed bank fraud cases, including CC-5026 and CC-2860. The total suspicious amount is $99.92. The card C07987-K2 has been blocked, and connected cards C06224-K2 and C11309-K1 are now under monitoring.
